MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 17
   C. 25
   D. 27

3. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

4. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x < 5

5. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 156
   D. 144

6. Solve for x: x + 6 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 18
   C. 6
   D. 13

7. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 9

8. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 5

9. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 32
   C. 4
   D. 33

10. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 14

11. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

12. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 26

13. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 12
   C. 13
   D. 7

14. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 7
   C. 1
   D. 7

15. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 40
   C. 3
   D. 13

16. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 400

17. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 121

18. Solve for x: x + 3 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 11
   C. 10
   D. 3

19. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

20. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 24

21. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 12
   D. 24

22. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 36

23. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

24. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 29
   C. 11
   D. 3

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
